full_judgment: 15. However, we find from the cross-examination of the plaintiff (P.W.1) that he was in fact challenged with regard to his claim that his father was the brother of Askar Mondal. Hence, the observation of the trial Court clearly shows misreading of the evidence. Moreover, the trial Court appears to have overlooked the plaintiffs contradictory claim that "Askar Mondal during his lifetime also gifted the S.L. to my father by executing the unregistered deed". The trial Court also disbelieved the defendants' case of surrender and pattan because no supporting evidence was adduced. The trial Court thus fell into error in shifting the burden of proof on to the defendants. We further note that the trial Court did not discuss the evidence of the DWs or the documents produced by the defendants.
